_meta.description: Bright Smiles Dental - Query 6: reviews are all 6+ months old, about old dentist

gp_bright_smiles.name: Bright Smiles Dental
gp_bright_smiles.address: 450 Sutter St, Suite 300, San Francisco, CA 94108

rev_bsd_001.text: Dr. Morrison is fantastic! Gentle hands and really takes time to explain procedures. Best dental experience I've had. The office is modern and clean.

rev_bsd_002.text: Dr. Morrison did a great job on my crown. Painless procedure and the fit was perfect. Staff is friendly. Scheduling is easy online.

rev_bsd_003.text: Love Dr. Morrison's approach - very patient-focused. Wait times can be a bit long but the quality of care makes up for it. Been going here for years.

rev_bsd_004.text: Dr. Morrison is good but the pricing is on the higher side. Insurance processing was slow. The dental work itself was quality though.
